arguments.new_text:
import chess

FEN = "r1bq1r2/1p3pp1/p1n1p3/3nPkbP/8/P1N5/1P2QPP1/R1B1K2R w - - 0 1"

board = chess.Board(FEN)
print("FEN valid:", board.is_valid())
print(board)
print("turn:", board.turn, " check:", board.is_check(), " checkmate:", board.is_checkmate())

moves = list(board.legal_moves)
print("num legal moves:", len(moves))

# 1) mate in 1
mates1 = []
for m in moves:
    board.push(m)
    if board.is_checkmate():
        mates1.append(m)
    board.pop()
print("mate in 1:", [str(m) for m in mates1])

# 2) find all checking moves
checks = [m for m in moves if board.gives_check(m)]
print("checking moves:", [str(m) for m in checks])

# 3) capture moves
caps = [m for m in moves if board.is_capture(m)]
print("captures:", [str(m) for m in caps])
